component.name: Vingilot
component.summary: Native GTK4/Libadwaita web browser with AI assistance and local sync

description.p: Vingilot is a privacy-first, native Linux web browser designed for desktop and mobile. It features WebKitGTK 6.0 rendering, Círdan local encrypted password manager, Navigating Shadowy Seas private incognito browsing, and offline portable sync bundles.
